---
Sub Domain: Regulations

Date of Circular: 20 January 2026
Effective Date: 20 January 2026

Gist of Amendment:
The SEBI has issued this circular to amend Regulation 15 of the Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements. The changes include replacing "regulation" with "regulations", omitting a specific number, changing "chapter" for "Chapter", and increasing the minimum non-convertible debt securities holding from One Thousand Crore to Five Thousand Crore.

Existing Provisions Prior to Amendment:
Regulation 15 specified various requirements related to the composition of board of directors, age limit for non-executive directors, and vigil mechanism/whistleblower policy for listed entities.

Summary:
The SEBI has issued this circular and amended Regulation 15 of the Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements. The changes aim to clarify and strengthen certain provisions related to board composition, age limit for non-executive directors, and vigil mechanism/whistleblower policy for listed entities. Specifically, the amendments replace "regulation" with "regulations", omit a specific number, change "chapter" for "Chapter", and increase the minimum non-convertible debt securities holding from One Thousand Crore to Five Thousand Crore.
